question: Should CodexBar CLI runtime fail closed when Claude cannot prove authentication through auth status --json, even if an older or wrapped CLI might still support interactive usage?
rationale: The patch fixes the reported logged-out delay, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for CLI installations outside the supported auth-status contract; tests cannot decide whether that compatibility break is acceptable for CLI runtime.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed CLI runtime
options.body: Apply the same non-interactive authentication contract to CLI runtime, preventing logged-out hangs while making incompatible wrappers unavailable.

options.title: Preserve interactive compatibility
options.body: Keep or design a fallback for unusable auth-status responses, accepting either the original delay or additional policy complexity.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed CLI runtime
recommendation.body: Apply the same non-interactive authentication contract to CLI runtime, preventing logged-out hangs while making incompatible wrappers unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged and documented the existing fail-closed authentication policy and is best positioned to approve extending it to CLI runtime.
